newsitem.title: EGYPT: Tuesday last day for AAIB bond applications.
newsitem.headline: Tuesday last day for AAIB bond applications.

text.p: Arab African International Bank's offer of five-year floating-rate notes worth 300 million pounds ($88 million) is fully subscribed and it will stop accepting applications at the end of work on Tuesday, the agents said.

The notes will pay interest every three months, at 0.25 percentage points above the average yield on 91-day treasury bills over the three-month period, the bank said. The average yield on 91-day bills was 9.946 at the last auction.
If the treasury does not issue 91-day bills, the interest will be 2.75 percentage points below the Central Bank discount rate, which now stands at 12.75 percent.
The offer opened on March 5 and by law it had to stay open for at least 10 days.
